DIAGNOSIS READY: Posterior Fossa Tumour (e.g., Brainstem Glioma or Cerebellar Tumour)

The combination of a new-onset headache and progressive visual changes in a 69-year-old woman, without systemic symptoms like fever or weight loss, is highly concerning for an intracranial mass effect. Given the duration and specific visual progression, this warrants immediate neuroimaging to evaluate for posterior fossa pathology.
